## reference · AI Search Citation Mechanics (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity)

*   **Platform Sourcing Logic**
    *   **ChatGPT:** Hybrid model using static training data (cutoff-based) and Bing-powered retrieval. Retrieval triggers primarily for commercial-intent queries (e.g., "reviews," "comparison," "2026") at a 53.5% rate vs. 18.7% for informational queries.
    *   **Google AI Overviews:** Powered by Gemini, drawing from the organic search index. Decoupling from organic rank is accelerating: only ~17–38% of cited pages rank in the top 10 organic (down from 76% in mid-2025). 47% of citations come from pages ranking below position 5.
    *   **Perplexity:** Real-time web search for every query (no knowledge cutoff). Cites content published within the last 30 days at an 82% rate. Averages 21.87 citations per response (highest volume), reducing competition per slot.

*   **Citation Source Preferences**
    *   **ChatGPT:** Favors encyclopedic authority. Wikipedia accounts for 7.8% of all citations (47.9% of top sources). Skews older: ~29% of citations reference content from 2022 or earlier.
    *   **Google AI Overviews:** Balanced mix. Reddit is the #1 cited source (2.2% share). LinkedIn appears in top 10 sources with a 13% share. YouTube titles/transcripts are the strongest correlating factor for visibility.
    *   **Perplexity:** Favors real-time community and recency. Reddit accounts for 46.7% of top citation sources. Brand citation rate is 13.05% (vs. 0.59% for ChatGPT).

*   **Content Structure & Optimization Rules**
    *   **Positional Weighting:** Front-load answers. The first 30% of page content accounts for 44.2% of LLM citations; the middle 30–70% accounts for 31.1%; the final 30% accounts for 24.7%.
    *   **Semantic Completeness:** Strongest predictor for Google AI Overviews (correlation r=0.87). Content must provide self-contained answers without external context.
    *   **Structured Data:** FAQPage, Article, and BreadcrumbList schema are critical. FAQ schema correlates with ~40% higher citation weighting in ChatGPT and 73% selection rate improvement in AI Overviews.
    *   **Multimodal Integration:** Text combined with images/video shows 156% higher selection rates in AI Overviews versus text-only.
    *   **Freshness Signals:** Visible year signals (e.g., "2026" in titles/headings) improve Perplexity citation rates by ~30%. 53% of cited content is updated within 6 months; pages updated within 12 months are 2x more likely to be cited.

*   **Authority & E-E-A-T Signals**
    *   **Third-Party Presence:** Domains with active profiles on third-party review platforms have 3x higher citation probability in ChatGPT.
    *   **Original Data:** Including proprietary statistics or original research increases AI visibility by 22%. Direct quotations boost visibility by 37%.
    *   **Earned Media:** Distributing content to external publications increases AI citations by up to 325% compared to owned media only. 90% of brand visibility citations originate from earned/owned media.
    *   **E-E-A-T:** Pages with strong E-E-A-T indicators (verifiable credentials, explicit dates) show 22% higher visibility in AI results.

*   **Traffic & Conversion Metrics**
    *   **Click-Through:** Pages cited in AI Overviews earn 35% more organic clicks than non-cited competitors on the same SERP.
    *   **Conversion Rate:** LLM referral traffic converts at 1.66% for signups vs. 0.15% for traditional organic search (~11x improvement). Perplexity delivers the highest ROI per citation due to high-intent user base (analysts, journalists).
